summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Dashboard header XP + streak pill chips for Grade K-3, and Grade 4-5 regression. Tested with real playwright viewports (390x844 mobile for G1, 1920x1080 desktop for G4). All acceptance criteria pass.

grade1_mobile_390x844.header-xp-chip_text:
⭐
30 XP (matches real My XP wallet balance = 30)
grade1_mobile_390x844.header_items_bounding: xp_chip(45-128), streak_chip(144-242), notification-bell(258-298), profile(314-318), logout(334-374) — all within 0..390, no wrap, no clipping
grade1_mobile_390x844.console_errors: Only an unrelated 401 (pre-login auth-check ping) — no header-related errors

grade4_desktop.header-streak-chip_text: 1 (bare number, no 'days' suffix — old style preserved)
grade4_desktop.header-streak-chip_classes: bg-[#FFD23F]/20 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#1D3557] (thick navy border retained)

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx is 996 lines — over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting header, K-3 layout, and 4-5 layout into subcomponents (not blocking, but growing).

The profile <Link> in header has no visible width when the avatar image hasn't loaded yet (measured 4px wide during test); harmless but consider adding min-w on the anchor to keep spacing stable during image load.
Streak chip label reads '1 days' for streak=1 (should ideally pluralize to '1 day'); minor copy nit, not a bug per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header chips confirmed working correctly on real 390x844 mobile viewport (previous main-agent tool quirk about viewport is resolved on this side). No overflow, all interactions still work.
